summary: Bound CommonKVManager's prefill-side ZMQ endpoint cache with configurable LRU eviction, close PUSH and monitor sockets as one lifecycle, skip sockets with an active sender, and clean up atomically when monitor creation fails.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual checked-out _connect retained all six unique endpoint PUSH/monitor pairs rather than the configured three; endpoint reuse passed. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9ae404b41c46/evidence/failing-before.txt

Five focused tests passed: bounded unique endpoints, paired close, stable reuse, LRU recency, active-sender protection, and atomic monitor-creation failure cleanup. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9ae404b41c46/evidence/passing-after-focused-final.txt

With cache_limit=8, 200 unique endpoints ended with 8 PUSH entries and 8 monitor entries; /proc/self/fd was 9 before, 39 after, and peaked at 48. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9ae404b41c46/evidence/fd-bounded.txt
